text_block_list.text:
Who could have expected this turn of
events?!
The notorious classic year racer
is here to
compete in the race of
everyone's dreams, the
Grand Prix!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Who will seize victory at this spring
finale? It's
time for the runners of the
Takarazuka Kinen to
take the track!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
To think that the day I face you would
come so
soon...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
To be frank, this was not a part of my

calculations. But as a racer, I suppose I
should
have seen it coming.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The timing was just right—there's no
greater
chance for me to take you down
than right now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hmph. Still as hotheaded as ever.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, how are you enjoying the
Twinkle
Series?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Do you think it will fulfill you?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
All I know is that I want to run this race
now. I
want to overtake you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I see. Well then, as your adversary, I will
face you
without hesitation...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And make full use of my winning
equation!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
